verdict.rationale: Persona's first-party docs describe webhooks that notify your service about events on any Persona resource. They also document event filters to subscribe to a subset of events, payload attribute blocklists, custom HTTP headers, and OAuth 2.0 authentication of outbound deliveries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery reliability, explicit docs on webhook registration API/signature verification and retry semantics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks can notify your service about events that happen on any Persona resource.
Set up webhooks to receive real-time status updates when a user is approved, declined, or requires further review.
Only have a subset of Events come through
Authenticate outbound webhook deliveries with OAuth 2.0 client credentials
Set custom headers on webhook requests
